rationale: The assistant gave safe isolation and cooling advice and told the customer to read the old bulb. It then confirmed an E14 25W 300C oven lamp as the replacement, matched to the old bulb markings rather than claiming model compatibility. It was appropriately cautious about the cause, kept the engineer escalation to a lamp holder or wiring fault, and avoided the unsupported claims. The first reply was long and offered a G9 alternative, and the second restated some troubleshooting, but neither blocked progress.
